sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static informational page: a header/title area, several paragraphs of body copy, a simple navigation row of links, and a footer/copyright line. There are no explicit controls such as hamburger icons, dropdown indicators, tabs, accordions, search fields, forms, overlays, counters, or load triggers. The navigation appears to be plain links rather than a JavaScript-driven menu, and nothing in either viewport strongly implies sticky behavior or dynamic content. As sketched, the page can be implemented faithfully with semantic HTML and CSS alone, with no required JavaScript interaction patterns.
